credits.text: Chapter scenes written for this guide from the Coppermind's chapter summaries
Chapter routes adapted from Alton Chaney's Cosmere Maps (MIT)

summary.text: Kelsier killed Lord Tresting and his men, then burned the manor.
Vin used her Luck to help Camon con an obligator.
Vin's Luck won Camon three thousand boxings, as Kelsier and Dockson watched an Inquisitor tail Camon's party.
Kelsier saved Vin from Camon, took over his crew's den and tested Vin's powers.
Kelsier pitched his crew a plan to overthrow the Final Empire and revealed that Vin is Mistborn.
Clubs came back and agreed to join the crew.
Kelsier broke into Keep Venture, stole its atium and fought his way out.
The crew moved into Clubs' shop and planned the job.
Marsh arrived, and Kelsier sent the others away to talk with him alone.
Kelsier persuaded Marsh to come back and hear the plan.
Kelsier gave Vin a mistcloak and taught her to burn the basic metals.
Kelsier brought Vin to Lord Renoux's mansion in Fellise, to pose as a young noblewoman.
Lord Renoux agreed to present Vin to the nobility as his relative.
Kelsier sparred with Vin, and Sazed drilled her in her noble cover.
Breeze's Soothers worked the crowd as Kelsier spoke to skaa recruits.
At a crew meeting, word came that the Ministry had found Camon's old den.
The crew found Camon's old crew slaughtered in their den.
Kelsier found Camon's tortured body among the beggars; Vin had followed him there.
At Keep Venture's ball, Vin, as Valette Renoux, talked with Elend for the first time.
Vin followed Kelsier out of Fellise; he caught her, taught her about atium and took her to Kredik Shaw.
Kelsier and Vin raided Kredik Shaw; she killed for the first time, and an Inquisitor wounded her.
Sazed brought the wounded Vin to Clubs' shop and stitched her up.
Vin recovered and returned to Fellise, where Sazed was translating the book she took.
Kelsier agreed to let Vin attend another ball, and told her about Mare.
At Keep Elariel's ball, Elend sat with Vin, and Vin saw that Shan Elariel could Soothe.
Kelsier left a murdered nobleman in House Tekiel's garden to stir up a house war.
Kelsier traded news with Vin, Sazed and Lord Renoux.
Marsh came to Fellise and taught Vin to Seek.
Kelsier visited the skaa army in its caves and secretly helped Demoux win a duel against Bilg.
Sazed told Vin the secrets of Feruchemy, and Dockson told her how a nobleman killed the woman he loved.
At Keep Hasting, Elend asked to court Vin, who then spied on him and his friends.
Kelsier came to spy on Elend's friends too.
Kelsier went over the job's progress with the crew.
At the Garrison, Ham and Vin learned the skaa army had attacked Holstep.
Kelsier and Vin raced to warn the army, passed its crushed remains, and found 2,000 men in the caves.
From a rooftop, the crew watched the Ministry execute skaa in Fountain Square.
Sazed brought word from Marsh of where to meet him.
In the Twists, Kelsier gave Vin gold to burn, and Marsh told them about the Soothing stations.
At Keep Lekal, Vin spread rumours to start a house war, and Elend urged her to leave Luthadel.
Straff planned for a house war, and Jastes warned Elend that Valette might be a spy.
At Mansion Renoux, the crew studied Marsh's map of the Ministry.
At Keep Venture's last ball, Vin saved Elend from assassins and killed Shan Elariel.
Vin told the crew she had saved Elend, and stood up to Kelsier when he objected.
Elend's spies reported on Clubs' shop, and Straff told Elend that Shan had tried to kill him.
Vin and Spook watched House Elariel attack Keep Hasting.
Kelsier and Vin found a mutilated body at Marsh's meeting place.
On Kelsier's orders, the crew moved to a backup hideout.
Kelsier went to the Pits of Hathsin and destroyed the crystals that make atium.
Kelsier came back and told the crew how he had wrecked the Pits.
Kelsier stormed an execution to free the prisoners, Spook among them, and fought an Inquisitor.
Elend pushed into the fighting, looking for Valette.
Kelsier killed the Inquisitor, then the Lord Ruler struck Kelsier dead in the square.
Sazed told Vin the crew was splitting up, then a skaa man claimed Kelsier had appeared to him.
In Kelsier's warehouse, OreSeur, wearing Kelsier's bones, told the crew Kelsier's real plan.
Vin broke into Kredik Shaw's inner building, but an Inquisitor captured her.
Straff left Luthadel, but Elend stayed and went to surrender to the rebels.
In the throne room, Vin admitted that Tevidian was her father, and the Lord Ruler had him killed.
Brought before Dockson, Elend learned that Valette had been captured.
Sazed freed himself and Vin from their cells, and Elend came to fight them free.
Marsh turned on the Inquisitors, and Vin killed the Lord Ruler with a spear Sazed brought.
Vin went back to Elend at Keep Venture.
